This page documents my dev/academic setup. For the apps and tools I currently use, I also provide alternatives that I've used previously or am familiar with.

## Fonts and Themes

-   [MonoLisa](https://monolisa.dev), [Berkeley Mono](https://usgraphics.com/products/berkeley-mono)
    -   *Alternatives*: [JetBrains Mono](https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono), [Monaspace](https://github.com/githubnext/monaspace)
-   Themes:
    -   [Tomorrow](https://github.com/chriskempson/tomorrow-theme)
    -   [Solarized](https://ethanschoonover.com/solarized/)
    -   [Rose Pine](https://rosepinetheme.com/themes/)
    -   [gruvbox](https://github.com/morhetz/gruvbox)

## Must-haves

-   **Password Manager:** [1Password](https://1password.com/) \$
    -   *Alternatives*: [Bitwarden](https://bitwarden.com/), [Proton Pass](https://proton.me/pass), [Dashlane](https://www.dashlane.com/)
-   **Launcher:** [Raycast](https://www.raycast.com/) \$, [Alfred](https://www.alfredapp.com/) \$
    -   *Alternatives*: [LeaderKey](https://github.com/mikker/LeaderKey.app)
-   **Browser:** [Arc](https://arc.net/)
    -   *Alternatives*: [Zen Browser](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop)
-   **Keyboard Customization:** [Karabiner-Elements](https://karabiner-elements.pqrs.org/)
    -   *Alternatives*: [Kanata](https://github.com/jtroo/kanata)
-   **Clipboard History**: [Pastebot](https://tapbots.com/pastebot/) \$
    -   *Alternatives*: Raycast/Alfred clipboard history features
-   **Window Management**: [Magnet](https://magnet.crowdcafe.com), [Raycast Windom Management](https://www.raycast.com/core-features/window-management)
-   **System Cleaning:** [CleanMyMac](https://macpaw.com/cleanmymac) \$
-   **Screenshots/Recording:** [CleanShot](https://cleanshot.com/) \$
    -   *Alternatives*: [Shottr](https://shottr.cc/)
-   **Reference Management:** [Zotero](https://www.zotero.org/) + [Better BibTex](https://github.com/retorquere/zotero-better-bibtex)
    -   *Alternatives*: Mendeley, EndNote
-   **RSS Feed Reader**: [Inoreader](https://www.inoreader.com) \$
    -   *Alternatives*: [Feedly](https://feedly.com/)

## Productivity/Utilities

-   **System Monitoring:** [iStat Menus](https://bjango.com/mac/istatmenus/) \$
    -   *Alternatives*: [Stats](https://bjango.com/mac/stats/)
-   **Menu Bar Organization:** [Bartender](https://bjango.com/mac/bartender/) \$
    -   *Alternatives*: [Ice](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice), [Hidden](https://github.com/Hidden), [Dozer](https://github.com/Mortennn/Dozer)
-   **App Switcher:** [AltTab](https://github.com/lwouis/alt-tab-macos)
    -   *Alternatives*: Use CMD+Tab
-   **Note Taking:** [Bear Notes](https://bear.app) \$
    -   *Alternatives*: Obsidian, Notion, Apple Notes, [Joplin](https://github.com/laurent22/joplin)
-   **PDF Handling:** [PDF Expert](https://pdfexpert.com/) \$, Preview
-   **Bookmark Management:** [Raindrop.io](https://raindrop.io/)
    -   *Alternatives*: Pocket, Instapaper
-   **Media Downloader**: [Downie](https://software.charliemonroe.net/downie/) \$
    - *Alternatives*: [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp)

## Development & CLI

### Shell & CLI Tools

-   **Terminal Emulator:** [Ghostty](https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty)
    -   *Alternatives*: [iTerm2](https://github.com/gnachman/iTerm2), [Kitty](https://github.com/kovidgoyal/kitty), [Alacritty](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty)
-   **Shell Prompt:** [Starship](https://starship.rs/)
    -   *Alternatives*: [Powerlevel10k](https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k), [Oh My Zsh prompts](https://ohmyz.sh/)
-   **Terminal Multiplexer:** [tmux](https://github.com/tmux/tmux)
    -   *Alternatives*: [Screen](https://www.gnu.org/software/screen/), [Zellij](https://zellij.dev/)
-   **Dotfile Manager:** [GNU Stow](https://www.gnu.org/software/stow/)
-   **CLI Utilities:**
    -   [gh](https://cli.github.com/): GitHub CLI
    -   [git-lfs](https://github.com/git-lfs/git-lfs): Git Large File System
    -   [bat](https://github.com/sharkdp/bat): `cat` with syntax highlighting
    -   [fzf](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf): Fuzzy finder
        -   *Alternatives* (for shell history): [mcfly](https://github.com/carljm/mcfly), [atuin](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin), [skim](https://github.com/skim-rs/skim)
    -   [ripgrep](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep): Fast `grep` alternative
    -   [fd](https://github.com/sharkdp/fd): `find` alternative
    -   [jq](https://jqlang.org/): JSON processor
    -   [glow](https://github.com/charmbracelet/glow): Terminal Markdown viewer
    -   [act](https://github.com/nektos/act): Run github actions locally

### Editors & IDEs

-   [Zed](https://zed.dev) (+ Preview)
    -   *Alternatives*: [Helix](https://helix-editor.com), [Sublime Text](https://sublimetext.com)
-   [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) (+ Insiders)
-   [Neovim](https://neovim.io/)
    -   *Alternatives*: [Vim](https://www.vim.org/)
-   [RStudio](https://posit.co/rstudio/)
    -   *Alternatives*: [Positron](https://posit.co/positron), [Radian](https://github.com/randy3k/radian), VS Code

### Programming Languages & Data Tools

-   [Python](https://python.org)
    -   Package/Env Management: [uv](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv) (*Alternatives*: pip, conda)
    -   Linter/Formatter: [ruff](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff)
-   [R](https://www.r-project.org/)
    -   Formatter: [air](https://github.com/posit-dev/air) (*Alternatives*: styler, formatR)
-   SQL & Big Data: [DuckDB](https://duckdb.org), [PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org)
    -   *Alternatives*: [SQLite](https://sqlite.org), [MySQL](https://mysql.com), [ClickHouse](https://clickhouse.com), [Polars](https://pola.rs)

### Web & API Hacking

-   [Bruno](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno): API client
    -   *Alternatives*: Insomnia, Postman
-   [Mitmproxy](https://github.com/mitmproxy/mitmproxy): HTTP inspection
    -   *Alternatives*: [Burp Suite](https://portswigger.net/burp)
-   [Android Emulator](https://developer.android.com/studio/run/emulator)

### Documentation & Literate Programming

-   [Quarto](https://quarto.org)
    -   *Alternatives*: R Markdown, [Litedown](https://github.com/yihui/litedown), Jupyter Notebooks
-   [Pandoc](https://pandoc.org): Document converter
-   [Typst](https://github.com/typst/typst): LaTeX alternative

## Security & Cloud

-   **Ad Blocking:** [AdGuard](https://adguard.com/) \$, [uBlock Origin](https://github.com/gorhill/uBlock)
-   **Firewall/Network monitoring:** [Little Snitch](https://www.obdev.at/products/littlesnitch/index.html) \$
-   **VPN:** [Hotspot Shield](https://www.hotspotshield.com/) \$
    -   *Alternatives*: [Mullvad VPN](https://mullvad.net/en), ProtonVPN, AdGuard VPN, Tailscale
-   **Cloud Storage:** [iCloud Drive](https://icloud.com) \$
    -   *Alternatives*: Google Drive, Dropbox, pCloud
-   **File Encryption:** [Cryptomator](https://cryptomator.org/)

## AI Tools

-   **Chat/Assistants:** [Claude](https://claude.ai), [ChatGPT](https://openai.com/), [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com), [Raycast AI](https://www.raycast.com/core-features/ai)
-   **Local LLMs:** [Ollama](https://github.com/ollama/ollama), [LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai/)
-   **CLI**: [Aider](https://github.com/Aider-AI/aider)
    - *Alternatives*: [Claude Code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code), [OpenAI Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex), [Open Interpreter](https://github.com/OpenInterpreter/open-interpreter)
-   **Transcription:** [SuperWhisper](https://superwhisper.com/)
    -   *Alternatives*: [MacWhisper](https://goodsnooze.gumroad.com/l/macwhisper)
